title: Bounded reasoning headroom for document writing
steps: Keep the user's per-task reasoning settings and add bounded total-completion headroom for Luna tailoring, statements and cover letters
Make headroom configurable per writing task and include it in immutable client keys/cache identities and diagnostics
Preserve small/non-reasoning and other-provider request limits; reject invalid configuration before inference
Test writing requests and total caps, run required verification, recreate the service and confirm active settings without paid AI calls
note: Headroom enlarges a bounded combined output/reasoning cap; it is not a provider guarantee of a separately reserved reasoning allowance.
